thread:
Sarah (Sales): Hey team — legal for the prospect needs a clear data path + subprocessor ownership matrix for the POC. They want: 1) data flow showing PII movement, 2) which subprocessors touch each hop, 3) KMS key ownership & regions, 4) retention/TTL, 5) proof-of-pseudonymization. They asked for artifacts by EOD Wed. Can someone own this? @Sam @Alex

Sam (Solutions): I can take the matrix. Quick clarifying Q: is this for Hosted API or Dedicated? That changes the subprocessors list.

Sarah (Sales): Hosted for now (US-hosted compute, but they’re worried about EU transit). They mentioned "no EU cross-border at rest" as a concern — do we have keys in EU?

Alex (Security): For our default hosted setup compute + storage are in us-east-1. KMS CMKs are in us-east-1 by default unless BYOK or region-locked customer request. I can produce a subprocessor mapping CSV + short evidence pack. Need a versioned diagram artifact for their risk team.

Mia (Eng): I have a preliminary diagram — uploaded to our shared assets: https://redwood.example.com/shared/diagrams/acme-poc-data-path.png. Also pasted a quick ascii sketch below for review:

```
Client -> Redwood API (us-east-1) -> Inference runtime (GPU pool, us-east-1)
  -> KV cache (Redis, us-east-1) -> Optional replica shard (eu-west-1, opt-in)
  -> Logs/metrics (Datadog) -> Retention TTL 30d (redacted logs)
KMS: CMK in us-east-1 (AWS KMS) unless BYOK configured by customer
Subprocessors (examples): AWS (compute/storage/KMS), Datadog (metrics), Sentry (errors), Segment (optional analytics)
```

Alex (Security): Please add explicit rows for what is persisted versus ephemeral: prompt text (cached short-term), embeddings (only if customer enables), logs (redacted by default). Also include pseudonymization note: we hash user IDs before storing.

Sam (Solutions): I'll assemble the ownership matrix mapping each subprocess to the data types they touch, legal basis, and contract link. Will include columns: subprocess_name, region, services_used, data_types, retention, DPA_link, SCCs, contact_owner. Format: CSV + PDF summary for legal.

Sarah (Sales): Perfect. Customer asked specifically for two deliverables: (A) 'Data paths + subprocessors matrix' CSV and (B) 'High-level boundary diagram' PDF. Can we commit ETA?

Mia (Eng): I can export diagram -> PDF and tidy labels by tomorrow 12:00pm PT.

Sam (Solutions): I’ll finish the CSV by EOD today. I’ll include KMS key ARNs (or placeholder if BYOK), region tags, and note whether logs contain PII.

Alex (Security): I’ll prepare a short evidence pack with DPA link, SOC2 summary, and subprocess agreement references. Expect to drop into the shared folder tomorrow afternoon. Also: we should call out optional mitigations the customer can enable (BYOK, private networking, EU-only routing).

Sarah (Sales): Awesome — I’ll tell the buyer we’ll deliver CSV + PDF + evidence pack within the timeline. Any immediate blockers?

deploy-bot: Artifact uploaded: https://artifacts.example.com/1748889999/diagram.pdf

Sam (Solutions): Uploaded draft CSV: https://redwood.example.com/shared/acme-poc-subproc-matrix.csv — contains current subprocess list + processing columns. Please review.

Sarah (Sales): Thanks everyone — I’m looping legal and the buyer now. I’ll post any follow-ups here. :thumbsup:
